segments.sn18.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.sn18.1:1.3: Atha kho āyasmā rāhulo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā rāhulo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn18.1:1.4: “sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desetu, yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyan”ti.
segments.sn18.1:2.4: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn18.1:2.6: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ –
segments.sn18.1:3.11: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn18.1:3.13: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ –
segments.sn18.1:4.1: “Evaṃ passaṃ, rāhula, sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati … pe … sotasmimpi nibbindati … ghānasmimpi nibbindati … jivhāyapi nibbindati … kāyasmimpi nibbindati … manasmimpi nibbindati;
segments.sn18.1:4.2: nibbindaṃ virajjati; virāgā vimuccati; vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
segments.sn18.1:4.3: ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānātī”ti.

lines: Atha vā uppādavayavantatāya tāvakālikatāya vipariṇāmakoṭiyā niccapaṭikkhepatoti imehipi kāraṇehi aniccaṃ.
Dukkhanti catūhi kāraṇehi dukkhaṃ dukkhamanaṭṭhena dukkhavatthukaṭṭhena satatasampīḷanaṭṭhena sukhapaṭikkhepenāti.
Taṇhāgāho cettha aṭṭhasatataṇhāvicaritavasena, mānagāho navavidhamānavasena, diṭṭhigāho dvāsaṭṭhidiṭṭhivasena veditabbo.
Nibbindaṃ virajjatīti ettha virāgavasena cattāro maggā kathitā, virāgā vimuccatīti ettha vimuttivasena cattāri sāmaññaphalāni.
Ettha ca pañcasu dvāresu pasādāva gahitā, manoti iminā tebhūmakaṃ sammasanacāracittaṃ.
Tatiye pañcasu dvāresu pasādavatthukacittameva, manoviññāṇena tebhūmakaṃ sammasanacāracittaṃ gahitaṃ.
Aṭṭhame pana taṇhāti tasmiṃ tasmiṃ dvāre javanappattāva labbhati.
Satiyā avippavasantoti satiyā avippavāsena ṭhito, sabbadā avijahanavasena pavatto.
Pahitattoti tasmiṃ visesādhigame pesitacitto, tattha ninno tappabbhāroti attho.
Hutvā abhāvākārenāti uppattito pubbe avijjamāno paccayasamavāyena hutvā uppajjitvā bhaṅguparamasaṅkhātena abhāvākārena.
Cakkhuñhi upādāya vikārāpajjanena vipariṇamantaṃ vināsaṃ paṭipīḷaṃ pāpuṇāti.
